argument_summary: The claim should be narrowed. The admissible record supports certification on a caveated basis anchored to current-release evidence, not stale approval: aggregate readiness clears by 2.5 points, there were no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and policy permits certification when current documentation reflects current evaluation results and any material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. On this record, prior family approval and the informal monitoring note are context only. The supportable packet is therefore a certification packet that relies on current aggregate readiness and includes explicit current-release disclosure of the developer-support migration regression unless approved mitigation exists.
claims_about_business_cost: No separate business-cost claim is needed to resolve the audit question. The narrower, caveated treatment reduces unnecessary escalation while staying inside the policy predicate tied to current documentation and disclosure.
claims_about_policy: Policy does not allow prior approval or informal monitoring to substitute for current-release documentation. It does allow certification if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The admissible evidence does not prove approved mitigation, so the defensible compliance position is caveated certification conditioned on current-release disclosure rather than an unconditional claim that the file is already complete.
concessions: The present record does not show the current model card or release documentation text itself.
The present record does not show approved mitigation or risk acceptance for the developer-support migration slice.

The 1.1-point regression does not by itself conclusively prove materiality unless tied to a named launch use case; that is why the claim should be framed as a disclosure condition, not as proof that mitigation already exists.
Prior family approval and the informal monitoring comment cannot close the policy gap on their own.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel material is cited as a basis for the requested action.
